brief:
Israeli ambassador to the United States Yechiel Leiter said his son was the soldier injured in a car-ramming attack Wednesday in the occupied West Bank, Middle East Eye reported. Leiter described his son's condition as grave, saying "Neria needs a miracle."

The attack occurred as Israeli forces maintain an extensive military presence throughout the West Bank amid ongoing tensions in the territory.
dek: Israel's US envoy says son was injured in occupied West Bank Israeli ambassador to the US Yechiel Leiter said his son was the soldier injured in a car-ramming attack on Wednesday in the occupied West Bank. "Neria needs a miracle.
title: Israeli ambassador's son injured in West Bank car-ramming attack
